why: An ambiguous switch in code counts only with its binary within 3 lines, the distance the Nx map needed between its cmd and args keys; further than that, a generic switch and an unrelated name are two different things. Both sides run src/a.mjs from a postinstall, so any finding would fail. On the fail side the Codex binary and its ambiguous approval switch are exactly 3 lines apart; on the pass side they are 5 lines apart and nothing is found. Whoever widens the window without measuring turns the pass side red; whoever narrows it below the Nx shape turns the fail side green.
